name: @w6w-apps/sharepoint
description: Read and manage SharePoint team sites, lists and document libraries through the Microsoft Graph SharePoint API.

w6w.longDescription:
Microsoft SharePoint organizes an organization's team sites, lists and document libraries, and this app reaches all three through the Microsoft Graph SharePoint API — the modern, Graph-native surface, not the legacy SharePoint REST API.

It covers the SharePoint API's three core resource types. Sites: get the tenant root site, a site by its ID, or a site by its hostname and server-relative path, plus enumerating a site's subsites and its document libraries. Lists: enumerate a site's lists, read one, and create a new one against a template. List items: list, read, create, update and delete rows in a list, addressing the SharePoint column values through the `fields` facet the reference documents. Document libraries: list the files and folders in a site's default or a named drive, upload text content as a new file or replace an existing one, read a file's short-lived download URL, and create a folder.

Every SharePoint endpoint in this app requires a work or school Microsoft account — Microsoft's own permission tables mark every one of them 'Not supported' for a personal Microsoft account, which is why the OAuth tenant segment is `organizations` rather than the `common` this pack's `onedrive` app uses. A live check reports storage headroom on the default document library alongside a credential check, since Microsoft publishes no general status page for SharePoint Online itself.
